verses.text: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

segments.text: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.

verses.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

segments.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures;
He leadeth me beside still waters.

verses.text: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

segments.text: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

segments.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil; for thou art with me;
Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.

verses.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

segments.text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies:
Thou hast anointed my head with oil;

verses.text: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.

segments.text: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life;
